channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: U.S. ready to return to ‘commitments,’ Iran says as Strait of Hormuz deal looms
item.description: Iran denied it was in talks with Washington, despite claims by Trump to the contrary.

item.title: World's biggest spirits maker pops 7% on $1 billion cost-cutting plan
item.description: Diageo, whose brands include Johnnie Walker scotch whisky, Captain Morgan rum and Guinness stout, said costs relating to the savings program will amount to $1.2 billion.

item.title: Warner Bros. Discovery reports 10% jump in streaming revenue ahead of proposed Paramount combination
item.description: Warner Bros. Discovery's streaming segment surpassed $3 million in revenue for the second quarter, marking a 10% increase from the year prior

item.title: Stocks making the biggest moves premarket: Zillow, Peloton, Sandisk, Moderna & more
item.description: These are the stocks posting the largest moves in the premarket.

item.title: This software stock was once a top performer. Piper Sandler says stay away
item.description: Analyst James Callahan downgraded the ad software stock to neutral from overweight.

item.title: Peloton posts first ever annual net profit, but shares drop as outlook disappoints
item.description: Peloton delivered its first ever annual profit in fiscal 2026 but it's still working to generate sales growth as consumers pull back on big ticket purchases.

item.title: Ukraine’s military hits one of Russia’s biggest oil refineries in long-range drone attack
item.description: The Slavneft-Yanos facility in Yaroslavl, which is situated hundreds of miles from the Ukraine border, is one of Russia's biggest oil refineries.

item.title: Google is expanding its AI empire — and losing the people who built it
item.description: Google’s cloud boom is testing the company's commitment to frontier AI as commercial returns take priority.

item.title: Restaurant Brands International earnings beat as Burger King's U.S. business soars
item.description: Burger King's U.S. business reported same-store sales growth of 8.5%.

item.title: Versant raises 2026 outlook on strength of platforms segment and advertising momentum
item.description: Versant noted revenue growth in its platforms business, which includes Fandango and GolfNow, and now, the recent acquisition of Full Swing.

item.title: Khanna to introduce 'Data Center Bill of Rights' as fight over AI power plants heats up
item.description: Michigan Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed, who won a competitive primary Tuesday, has endorsed state and local moratoriums on data centers.

item.title: JPMorgan's Jamie Dimon warns of high leverage: 'Somebody will disrupt the market'
item.description: JPMorgan Chief Executive Officer Jamie Dimon warned that leverage across financial markets remains elevated, adding that investors should be mindful that hidden borrowing could amplify market disruptions.

item.title: Hadrian valued at nearly $8 billion after fresh funding as money pours into defense tech
item.description: Hadrian is one of a number of defense tech startups raising large sums and benefiting from President Trump's plans to upgrade the U.S. military.

item.title: EU urges Caribbean nations to shut down golden passport programs or face travel restrictions
AstraZeneca may buck a decade of pharma strategy to buy U.S. scale
item.description: Reports of preliminary talks between AstraZeneca and Bristol Myers Squibb moved shares and reignited debate over Big Pharma consolidation.

item.title: Beijing flips the script on the U.S. tech war — and tests the truce weeks before Xi's visit
item.description: China unleashed its broadest package of trade countermeasures since last October's trade truce, pushing back against a string of recent U.S. restrictions.

item.title: Mexican jalapenos tied to Salmonella outbreak in 27 U.S. states
item.description: U.S. health officials are investigating a Salmonella outbreak linked to Mexican jalapeno peppers that has sickened 345 people in 27 states.

item.title: S&P 500 is experiencing violent surge often seen at major market tops. One chart analyst is worried
item.description: One chart analyst sees echoes of the dot-com bubble in the S&P 500's latest run-up, as the index has had a sharp surge often seen at major market tops.

item.title: E.l.f. Beauty sees $50 million windfall in tariff refunds as profits surge 100%
item.description: E.l.f. Beauty received $50 million in tariff refunds during its fiscal first quarter, leading profits to nearly double.

item.title: We're downgrading Honeywell Aerospace after a shockingly bad earnings debut
item.description: The company slashed its full-year guidance on key metrics in its first earnings report since separating from the Honeywell conglomerate in June.

item.title: SpaceX ramps up Tesla Megapack purchases in Q2 to power its AI data centers
item.description: SpaceX is using Tesla's big Megapack backup batteries to help power its Colossus AI data centers in Greater Memphis.

item.title: Fun isn't cheap anymore. Here's how your credit card can help cut the cost
item.description: If you're looking to save funds on fun, CNBC Select dives into a variety of credit card perks that can help.

item.title: Fed Governor Cook says she's 'prepared to act' on rate hike to address inflation
item.description: Cook was part of a 9-3 majority that voted last week to keep the central bank's benchmark borrowing rate in a range between 3.5%-3.75%.

item.title: Marc Benioff gets a new operating chief, as Salesforce promotes Miguel Milano
item.description: Salesforce promoted revenue head and former Oracle executive Miguel Milano to role of operating chief.

item.title: Meta debuts first AI coding agent to take on Anthropic and OpenAI
item.description: Meta released its first coding agent called Muse Code as the company ramps up its investments in AI models and services to try and take on Anthropic and OpenAI.

item.title: SoftBank gets $8.2 billion boost from Intel as OpenAI takes a backseat
item.description: SoftBank on Thursday reported profit for its fiscal first quarter that beat market expectations.

item.title: Etsy laying off 12% of staff in bid to streamline business, position for growth
item.description: Etsy announced the layoffs along with second-quarter earnings.

item.title: Jim Cramer says investors should consider buying SpaceX for their kids
item.description: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said investors should view SpaceX as a multigenerational investment, whose biggest opportunities may take decades to fully materialize.

item.title: Asian tech stocks drop with SK Hynix plunging 10% after Wall Street AI names fall
item.description: Despite heightened volatility analysts remain optimistic over the outlook of the tech sector, with J.P. Morgan saying the tech sell-off had not derailed the AI investment cycle.

item.title: Hollywood is cranking out billion-dollar movies again. 'Spider-Man' just joined the ranks
item.description: Box office analysts say the resurgence of billion-dollar releases bodes well for a film industry that's still chasing pre-Covid levels, even with higher prices.
